items.note: Built and live. Your clock in / clock out in My Day now goes straight into our own QuickBooks as your hours — one entry per day, approved in a batch on my end. Nothing changes in how you clock: same buttons, same routine. If you fix a missed clock-out afterwards, the correction follows it in automatically, and a day can never go in twice. Keep workforce for this one payroll run so we can confirm the two match, then drop it and you're down to one place. Thanks for your patience on the wait.
